title: Brand New, Keeps shutting down
text: Brand New, Keeps shutting down. I've waited years to finally put the money down for this vacuum.  I wish I hadn't!  The reviews on this vacuum from the "Experts" were glowing, but, none of them touched on what I now know is a common problem.  It shuts down.  It's said it's from overheating, or from a clog, or from wires that may have become detached.  All I know is that I have only used it four times and the 4th time it kept shutting down completely.  I changed an almost empty bag hoping that was the problem. Then went for help on the internet and seen how many people had this problem.  I've done what I can at home, now I'll attempt a call to Miele.  We'll see how that goes.  I for sure will let you all know how that goes!
